title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
abstract: arXiv:2609.39757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals. translated_title: 重新审视策略上对抗式黑盒蒸馏：校准组级奖励几何以实现有效的优势构建
translated_abstract: 黑盒蒸馏是一种实用的途径，能够将仅通过 API 暴露文本输出的大型语言模型的能力迁移到更小的学生模型中。近期的策略上对抗方法（如 GAD）通过在评论家与学生之间构建对抗循环来改进 SeqKD，其中评论家基于学生采样的响应，为基于 GRPO 的学生策略优化提供奖励。然而，GRPO 是从同一提示下学生样本的组内相对奖励来计算优势的，而评论家的训练目标主要是区分教师响应与学生响应。这种目标不匹配可能导致奖励组出现尺度坍缩或边缘脆弱的问题，从而产生脆弱的分组优化信号。我们提出了组级奖励几何条件化（GRGC），这是一个两阶段框架，通过在评论家训练（及学生优化）过程中塑造学生侧的奖励组来改进优势构建。（注：摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文针对评论家奖励目标与 GRPO 组内优势计算之间的不匹配问题，提出组级奖励几何条件化（GRGC）两阶段框架，通过校准学生侧奖励组的几何结构，在策略上对抗式黑盒蒸馏中实现更稳定有效的优势构建。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that addresses the objective mismatch between the critic's reward training and GRPO's within-group advantage computation by calibrating the geometry of student-side reward groups, enabling more stable and effective advantage construction in on-policy adversarial black-box distillation.
